about_the_game:
Rescue, heal, and care for abandoned animals in a heartfelt life sim.

Build and expand your own shelter, create cozy spaces for your furry friends, and unlock new facilities. Manage resources, upgrade your shelter, and experience the joy of giving them a second chance.

Key Features:

  • Rescue and Nurture Animals: Find abandoned, injured, or frightened animals and care for them through interactive mini-games.

  • Build and Expand Your Shelter: Personalize and upgrade your shelter, adding facilities like pet stores and pharmacies.

  • Resource Management: Collect and manage resources to keep your shelter running smoothly.

  • Emotional Connections: Earn the trust of each animal to give them a second chance at a better life.

  • Cozy and Relaxing: A warm, heartwarming experience with gentle challenges to enjoy at your own pace.

About the Challenges:

Some rescued animals may arrive scared, anxious, or even aggressive due to past trauma. Through our unique Trust-Building System, you'll engage in gentle interactions, mini-games, and consistent care to slowly earn their trust. Each small breakthrough—like allowing you to feed them or play—marks real progress on their journey to recovery and adoption.

Gameplay:

Start by rescuing animals in need, each with unique personalities and requirements. Build and customize your shelter, creating safe spaces for your furry friends. Manage your resources and hire staff, including veterinarians and caretakers, to keep everything running smoothly.

As your shelter grows, unlock new facilities like a pet pharmacy or pet food store. Upgrade your shelter with specialized equipment and create an efficient system to care for more animals. Make strategic decisions to ensure the well-being of both your animals and your business, balancing resource management with emotional connections.

💬 Join the Journey

This is just the beginning — we're building this heartfelt experience together! If you have ideas, suggestions, or just love cozy games with purpose, we’d love to hear from you. Join our community on Discord and help shape the future of the game!
